Youth Pastor

Pastor Jaden leads our youth, discipling young people through real relationships rather than programs.

Youth

Camps

Sundays

At Faith Life.

Pastor Jaden is at the forefront of how our church does youth ministry: by discipleship, not by program. He walks with young people, opens the Bible with them, and helps them follow Jesus.

He is a gifted speaker and one of the most theologically thoughtful people in our church. He has spoken at youth events and summer Bible camps, and he shares the Sunday preaching with Pastor Ian and Pastor Wendell.

Listen to Sunday messages

Outside Sunday.

Ask anyone at Faith Life and they will tell you Pastor Jaden is a great friend. He carries the warmth our church values when meeting someone new.

He is training to be a high school teacher and is preparing to marry his fiancée, Venice.
